text:
jules_ae: Quick heads-up — Miralabs onboarding metrics: steady ~120 rps in prod, but p95 latency climbed to ~420ms on redwood-gpt-small-2 over the last 24h. Theyalso flagged budget pressure for Q2. I want to propose a low-risk perf optimization: enable int8 quant on a dedicated pod pool and add a routing rule to divert short/simple requests to a compact model, with a canary + synchronous fallback to gpt-small-2 for low-confidence outputs. Plan to present conservative savings and rollback steps. Thoughts?

sam_cs: sounds reasonable. customer needs clear % savings and a rollback plan they can sign off on. can we give conservative/expected/optimistic numbers? :thinking_face: 

olivia_se: yes. expected token-cost reduction: conservative ~30%, expected ~36%, optimistic ~45% depending on average sequence length and cache hit rate. we should present three scenarios and highlight where savings come from (quant + routing + KV cache).

olivia_se: routing idea: send requests with tokens < 120 AND prompt_similarity > 0.60 to redwood-compact-v1. keep gpt-small-2 for long sessions, high-temp generation, or known-critical prompts. enable KV prefix caching for authenticated API keys.

mike_eng: can implement a 10% canary with metric gates: latency_p95, token_cost, and a fidelity score from our eval harness. gate thresholds: if fidelity delta > 3 points -> auto rollback. also add a low-confidence synchronous fallback: if compact returns confidence < 0.55 OR flagged_tokens > 5% -> route to gpt-small-2. aim to keep fallback latency overhead < +120ms.

deploy-bot: canary deployment started: miralabs-compact-routing-canary-2026-03-22  10% traffic; initiated 2026-03-22T15:12:00Z

jules_ae: I uploaded a 40-query prompt set from Miralabs for regression checks. @mike_eng please wire those into the canary eval and alert if accuracy delta > 2.5 pts. Also add a short post-deploy feedback widget on their dashboard with 5 representative prompts to capture regressions quickly.

mike_eng: will do. adding the eval job + infra tag for dedicated int8 pool. PR planned by EOD, will include canary metrics dashboard and an automated rollback playbook.

jules_ae: customer-facing blurb for the email: "We will run a phased optimization: small-scale canary (10%) -> monitored rollout with fidelity gates -> full swap for qualifying traffic. Conservative cost savings ~30% with safeguards for quality and a quick rollback option." please use that wording.

sam_cs: i'll draft the customer note and attach the conservative/expected/optimistic scenarios and the rollback steps. looping in sales for any renewal impact messaging.

jules_ae: ops config snippet for review:
```
route:
  - condition: "tokens < 120 and prompt_similarity > 0.60"
    model: "redwood-compact-v1"
  - condition: "confidence < 0.55"
    fallback: "gpt-small-2"
  - default: "gpt-small-2"
quant:
  enabled: true
  precision: int8
canary:
  pct: 10
  metrics:
    - latency_p95
    - token_cost
    - fidelity_delta
```

mike_eng: also adding the gating rules to the rollout: if fidelity_delta > 3 -> rollback; if token_cost reduction < 15% after 24h -> pause and investigate.

jules_ae: good. let's keep this thread as the handoff. i'll post the customer email draft here once sam has it. thanks team :rocket:
